description: Find stores on CouponSwift by brand name, store slug or website domain (for example "hostinger", "bunny.net" or "https://www.nordvpn.com/pricing"). Returns up to 5 matching stores, best match first. For each store: its name, its category, the highest percentage discount among its current offers (null when no offer states a percentage), the number of active offers on its page, and the link to that page. The coupon codes themselves are not returned: open the store page to see them.

query.description: A brand name, a store slug or a website domain or URL, 2 to 80 characters.

name: find_store

activeOffers.description: Number of active offers shown on the store page.

maxDiscount.description: Highest percentage discount among the active offers, or null.

title: Find a store
